premises.text: Legacy desk phones and simple softphones do not add enough value for modern business communication
premises.evidence_span: a simple soft phone on your computer that doesn't bring more value

premises.text: A cloud phone system that connects to CRM, helpdesk, and BI keeps customer conversations recorded where work happens
premises.evidence_span: Airco connects with all the tools companies are using

premises.text: The system is simple enough for anyone anywhere to set up and talk to customers
premises.evidence_span: Airco is simple to set up, can be set up by anyone in the world

premises.text: A marketplace of integrations lets Airco and third-party vendors build an ecosystem for voice on the platform
premises.evidence_span: the first phone system in the world creating their marketplace

value.text: Know your customer and improve daily work through recorded, integrated conversations
value.evidence_span: know your customer, record all the conversation, and be able to improve your daily work

causal_links.evidence_span: We replace that. We make it a software
you can have a 360 view about your customer

notes: Fundraising, headcount, country count, and 4,000 businesses excluded as traction/history (§4.2). Phone-system-of-the-future treated as vision (§4.1(4)). Gorgias/Shopify example folded into marketplace premise.
